newsitem.title: UK: TLG says trading in line with expectations.
newsitem.headline: TLG says trading in line with expectations.

text.p: British light fitting group TLG Plc said on Tuesday current trading had remained in line with expectations despite the strength of sterling which continued to impact the business.
Chairman Hamish Bryce told the company's annual general meeting that, with the exception of Germany, TLG's European markets were beginning to stabilise.
He said in a statement the company was reducing costs and its manufacturing rationalisation programme, announced in May, was progressing according to plan.
TLG was also continuing to make progress in developing areas of the lighting market, such as in the Far East where in June it was awarded approximately 19 million stg of airfield lighting contracts.

"I remain confident that the actions we are taking, together with our strong market positions and continued investment in developing new products and markets, means that we are well placed to take advantage of prevailing market conditions," Bryce said.
